product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic provides businesses’ sales and marketing representatives and service agents with multichannel messaging across SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and LINE to communicate with leads, customers, and prospects.
product_one_liner.notes: The product documentation describes the channels and identifies sales/marketing representatives and service agents as its target users.

pricing_page.notes: SMS-Magic has a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in SMS-Magic case-study listings.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports 312 employees as of May 31, 2026, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: SMS-Magic’s contact page labels its Henderson, Nevada location as its Global/USA Headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company profile sources identify SMS-Magic as founded in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents business/product how-to and promotional material; the evidence does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Technical Resource Center includes multiple guides, FAQs, release notes, and a Developer Guide.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The active careers board lists open roles but no AI/ML/data-science role title; the AI product-manager posting says it is no longer accepting applications.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, as an optional integration for customers’ own models; SMS-Magic does not identify it as its default model provider.
model_provider.notes: Product documentation describes connecting existing OpenAI models/bots to Conversive, rather than stating that OpenAI is the product’s default model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page names ISO 27001:2013 under security certificates and standards, and HIPAA and GDPR under industry-based compliance; it does not name SOC 2 or PCI DSS.

value.stage: Friends and family (historical prototype financing; no formal round recorded)

last_funding.notes: A March 2025 founder profile reports US$5,000 raised from friends and family to develop the initial prototype but does not date the financing. Tracxn reports no formal funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding profile reports no formal rounds, and the only reported friends-and-family prototype financing is described in a March 2025 article, before the 18-month window that began May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The active employer ATS lists Team Lead – Account Executive and SDR – Team Lead openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 26, 2026 release highlights introduce enhanced consent management with new configuration, capture, validation, export, and resolution capabilities.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current leadership chart lists long-tenured CEO, CTO, and VP of Product; the COO profile gives a September 2025 start, before the November 9, 2025 window. No C-level/VP arrival or departure in the window was found. The negative is based on the available leadership roster and profile evidence.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessors page identifies Salesforce for CRM and Pardot for marketing data management; SMS-Magic documentation has Zoho-specific product guides.
